breakdown.description: The listed S–N data show higher stress at longer life, opposite to the usual fatigue trend.
breakdown.reason: The incomplete prompt listed higher stress (260 MPa) at longer life (10^7 cycles), which contradicts the normal fatigue trend. The generated Basquin equation σₐ = 650·N^(−0.08) correctly reproduces 260 MPa at 10^5 cycles and 180 MPa at 10^7 cycles—matching the ground truth's corrected data ordering—and has a negative exponent confirming decreasing strength with increasing life.
